newsitem.title: USA: Boeing trades lower away from NYSE.
newsitem.headline: Boeing trades lower away from NYSE.

text.p: Boeing Co shares fell 3-1/2 to 98-1/2 in early third market trade Monday as the stock's New York Stock Exchange open was delayed due to an order imbalance after the company reported first quarter earnings, traders said.
Traders said they expected the stock to fall even further, given the NYSE's indication of a 89 to 91 opening.
The shares last traded on the NYSE Friday at 102.
Trader also said the shares were affected by a story about Lockheed Martin and Airbus Industrie
There was a British press report Saturday of merger discussion between Lockheed and Airbus.
An exective at Aerospatiale, Airbus's French partner, said Airbus and Lockheed have interests that would benefit from a link-up but said talk of a merger is premature.

Also, European Union and U.S. officials have begun talks on European complaints about U.S. aircraft maker subsidies and Boeing fears the outcome will be linked to an EU decision on its planned takeover of McDonnell Douglas Corp, according to Monday's Wall Street Journal.
